```{r}
#===============================================================================
# Figure 5: Interaction Plots — Schematic (A, B) + Real Data (C, D)
# Intermediate Wheatgrass (Thinopyrum intermedium)
#
# Author: Elizabeth Campbell
# Affiliation: Department of Tropical Plant and Soil Sciences,
#              University of Hawaii at Manoa
#
# Panels A & B: Schematic illustrations (unchanged from original)
# Panels C & D: Real data — SJ06_504005260 × BIO8 and SV07_374076699 × BIO9
#===============================================================================

library(ggplot2)
library(gridExtra)
library(dplyr)
library(vcfR)

# Setup
BASE_DIR   <- "C:/Users/Lizzy/OneDrive/Documents/UH_Manoa_Classes/IWG_Chapter_2"
OUTPUT_DIR <- file.path(BASE_DIR, "Analysis_Outputs_and_Visualizations/Figures")
DATA_DIR   <- file.path(BASE_DIR, "Data")
dir.create(OUTPUT_DIR, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

set.seed(42)

# Shared theme (identical to original)
shared_theme <- theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    legend.title      = element_blank(),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black"),
    plot.title        = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13, hjust = 0),
    plot.subtitle     = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 0),
    axis.title        = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    panel.grid.minor  = element_blank()
  )

pop_colors <- c(
  "Pop 1" = "#e41a1c", "Pop 2" = "#377eb8", "Pop 3" = "#4daf4a",
  "Pop 4" = "#984ea3", "Pop 5" = "#ff7f00", "Pop 6" = "#a65628"
)

#===============================================================================
# PANEL A: SCHEMATIC — DIVERGENT (unchanged from original)
#===============================================================================

climate_range <- seq(50, 200, length.out = 50)

populations_div <- list(
  "Pop 1" = list(slope = 0.0025,  intercept = 0.3,  color = "#e41a1c"),
  "Pop 2" = list(slope = 0.0010,  intercept = 0.45, color = "#377eb8"),
  "Pop 3" = list(slope = 0.0035,  intercept = 0.2,  color = "#4daf4a"),
  "Pop 4" = list(slope = 0.0015,  intercept = 0.5,  color = "#984ea3"),
  "Pop 5" = list(slope = 0.0005,  intercept = 0.55, color = "#ff7f00"),
  "Pop 6" = list(slope = -0.0005, intercept = 0.6,  color = "#a65628")
)

data_div <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(populations_div), function(pop) {
  params <- populations_div[[pop]]
  freq   <- params$slope * climate_range + params$intercept
  freq   <- pmax(0, pmin(1, freq))
  data.frame(
    climate     = climate_range,
    allele_freq = freq,
    population  = pop,
    color       = params$color
  )
}))

panel_a <- ggplot(data_div, aes(x = climate, y = allele_freq, color = population)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.2, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_color_manual(values = setNames(sapply(populations_div, `[[`, "color"),
                                       names(populations_div))) +
  labs(
    x        = "Precipitation Wettest Month (mm)",
    y        = "Allele Frequency",
    title    = "A. Divergent Adaptation: SJ02_159395471",
    subtitle = expression(paste("Significant G×P interaction (q = 5.2×10"^-9*", R² = 34.0%)"))
  ) +
  ylim(-0.05, 1.05) +
  shared_theme +
  theme(legend.position = c(0.15, 0.25)) +
  annotate("text", x = 180, y = 0.95,
           label = "Different slopes indicate\npopulation-specific effects",
           size = 3.5, hjust = 1)

#===============================================================================
# PANEL B: SCHEMATIC — PARALLEL (unchanged from original)
#===============================================================================

climate_range2 <- seq(30, 95, length.out = 50)

populations_par <- list(
  "Pop 1" = list(slope = 0.0080, intercept = 0.15, color = "#e41a1c"),
  "Pop 2" = list(slope = 0.0080, intercept = 0.25, color = "#377eb8"),
  "Pop 3" = list(slope = 0.0080, intercept = 0.10, color = "#4daf4a"),
  "Pop 4" = list(slope = 0.0080, intercept = 0.35, color = "#984ea3"),
  "Pop 5" = list(slope = 0.0080, intercept = 0.30, color = "#ff7f00"),
  "Pop 6" = list(slope = 0.0080, intercept = 0.20, color = "#a65628")
)

data_par <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(populations_par), function(pop) {
  params <- populations_par[[pop]]
  freq   <- params$slope * climate_range2 + params$intercept
  freq   <- pmax(0, pmin(1, freq))
  data.frame(
    climate     = climate_range2,
    allele_freq = freq,
    population  = pop,
    color       = params$color
  )
}))

panel_b <- ggplot(data_par, aes(x = climate, y = allele_freq, color = population)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.2, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_color_manual(values = setNames(sapply(populations_par, `[[`, "color"),
                                       names(populations_par))) +
  labs(
    x        = "Precipitation Seasonality (Coefficient of Variation, %)",
    y        = "Allele Frequency",
    title    = "B. Parallel Adaptation: SS01_212548100",
    subtitle = expression(paste("No G×P interaction (q = 0.19), genome-wide sig. (p = 7.6×10"^-9*", R² = 10.4%)"))
  ) +
  ylim(-0.05, 1.05) +
  shared_theme +
  theme(legend.position = c(0.15, 0.25)) +
  annotate("text", x = 90, y = 0.25,
           label = "Parallel slopes indicate\nuniversal adaptation",
           size = 3.5, hjust = 1)

#===============================================================================
# REAL DATA: Load VCF, clusters, bioclim
#===============================================================================

vcf_path     <- file.path(DATA_DIR, "Processed_Data/IWG_PI.vcf")
bioclim_path <- file.path(DATA_DIR, "Phenotype_and_Ecographic_Data/IWG_bioclim.csv")
cluster_path <- file.path(DATA_DIR, "Hierarchical Clusters/IWG_pca_clusters_k6.csv")

vcf      <- read.vcfR(vcf_path, verbose = FALSE)
bioclim  <- read.csv(bioclim_path, check.names = FALSE)
clusters <- read.csv(cluster_path)

# Cluster lookup
cluster_lookup <- setNames(as.character(clusters$Cluster), clusters$Accession)

# Helper: extract allele frequency for one SNP x bioclim combo
make_real_panel <- function(snp_id, bio_col, xlabel, title, subtitle,
                            ann_x, ann_y, ann_label, legend_pos,
                            panel_letter) {

  # Find SNP in VCF
  fixed   <- as.data.frame(getFIX(vcf))
  snp_idx <- which(fixed$ID == snp_id)
  if (length(snp_idx) == 0) stop(paste("SNP not found:", snp_id))

  ref <- fixed$REF[snp_idx]
  alt <- fixed$ALT[snp_idx]

  # Extract genotypes
  gt_mat <- extract.gt(vcf[snp_idx, ], element = "GT", as.numeric = FALSE)

  # Convert GT to alt allele frequency (0, 0.5, 1)
  gt_to_freq <- function(gt) {
    if (is.na(gt) || gt %in% c("./.", ".|.")) return(NA)
    alleles <- as.integer(strsplit(gt, "[/|]")[[1]])
    mean(alleles)
  }

  accessions <- colnames(gt_mat)
  af_vals    <- sapply(gt_mat[1, ], gt_to_freq)

  # Build data frame
  df <- data.frame(
    accession  = accessions,
    allele_freq = af_vals,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  # Add cluster and bioclim
  df$population <- paste0("Pop ", cluster_lookup[df$accession])
  df$climate    <- bioclim[[bio_col]][match(df$accession, bioclim[[1]])]
  df <- df[!is.na(df$population) & !is.na(df$climate) & !is.na(df$allele_freq), ]
  df <- df[df$population %in% paste0("Pop ", 1:6), ]

  # Global x range across all populations
  x_global_min <- min(df$climate, na.rm = TRUE)
  x_global_max <- max(df$climate, na.rm = TRUE)

  # Fit linear model per population and generate smooth line
  plot_data <- do.call(rbind, lapply(paste0("Pop ", 1:6), function(pop) {
    sub <- df[df$population == pop, ]
    if (nrow(sub) < 3) return(NULL)
    fit    <- lm(allele_freq ~ climate, data = sub)
    x_grid <- seq(x_global_min, x_global_max, length.out = 50)
    y_pred <- predict(fit, newdata = data.frame(climate = x_grid))
    y_pred <- pmax(0, y_pred)
    y_pred <- pmax(0, y_pred)
    data.frame(
      climate     = x_grid,
      allele_freq = y_pred,
      population  = pop,
      is_point    = FALSE
    )
  }))

  ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = climate, y = allele_freq, color = population)) +
    geom_line(size = 1.2, alpha = 0.8) +
    scale_color_manual(values = pop_colors) +
    labs(x = xlabel, y = "Allele Frequency",
         title = title, subtitle = subtitle) +
    ylim(-0.05, 1.05) +
    shared_theme +
    theme(legend.position = legend_pos) +
    annotate("text", x = ann_x, y = ann_y,
             label = ann_label, size = 3.5, hjust = 1)
}

#===============================================================================
# PANEL C: REAL DATA — POPULATION-SPECIFIC (SJ06_504005260 × BIO8)
#===============================================================================

panel_c <- make_real_panel(
  snp_id     = "SJ06_504005260",
  bio_col    = "wc2.1_30s_bio_8",
  xlabel     = "Mean Temp Wettest Quarter (°C×10)",
  title      = "C. Population-specific Adaptation: SJ06_504005260",
  subtitle   = "Significant G×P interaction (q = 1.92×10⁻²)",
  ann_x      = 18,
  ann_y      = 0.95,
  ann_label  = "Different slopes indicate\npopulation-specific effects",
  legend_pos = c(0.15, 0.75)
)

#===============================================================================
# PANEL D: REAL DATA — PARALLEL (SV07_374076699 × BIO9)
#===============================================================================

panel_d <- make_real_panel(
  snp_id     = "SV07_374076699",
  bio_col    = "wc2.1_30s_bio_9",
  xlabel     = "Mean Temp Driest Quarter (°C×10)",
  title      = "D. Parallel Adaptation: SV07_374076699",
  subtitle   = "No G×P interaction (q = 0.06)",
  ann_x      = 25,
  ann_y      = 0.95,
  ann_label  = "Parallel slopes indicate\nuniversal adaptation",
  legend_pos = c(0.15, 0.75)
)

#===============================================================================
# COMBINE AND SAVE — 2×2 layout
#===============================================================================

combined_plot <- arrangeGrob(panel_a, panel_b, panel_c, panel_d,
                              ncol = 2, nrow = 2)

ggsave(file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "Figure6_four_panel.png"), combined_plot,
       width = 14, height = 12, dpi = 300, bg = "white")

ggsave(file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "Figure6_four_panel.pdf"), combined_plot,
       width = 14, height = 12, bg = "white")

cat("\n✓ Figure 6 four-panel saved to:", OUTPUT_DIR, "\n")


```
